description: Validate a module schema without submitting anything. create_module (and update_module on full-canvas payloads) runs these same checks internally, so this tool is optional there — use it to iterate on a draft, or before a partial update_module where the merged canvas cannot be checked client-side.

mode.description: create = new module (all rules). update = merge (omitted sections acceptable).

schema.description: A complete or partial ModuleSchema object

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Omit if set via env or set_workspace; required in stateless/remote mode.

name: validate_design
title: Validate Design
